_note: Interference policy for web/accessory-drives.glb.gz. Touching is always allowed; overlap is not. known_defects is a ratchet: it records what the CURRENTLY PUBLISHED asset still contains, may only shrink, and an entry that is no longer observed fails the audit until it is removed. An empty list is the goal.

unverified_waivers.reason: The exported tessellation has 526 open seam edges, so an exact boolean cannot be built. The FreeCAD solid is valid (cad-verification.json). Its shaft and pad seats are checked in CAD. Fix at export: tessellate with shared edges.

known_defects.reason: Screen-plug shank (11 mm) runs through the pocket wall into the driven-gear teeth.
known_defects.fix: Shank shortened to 4 mm so it stops at the gear-pocket wall.

known_defects.reason: Lateral tach output shaft ends on the vertical shaft axis, 4.8 mm inside it.
known_defects.fix: Lateral shaft shortened to end 0.2 mm short of the vertical shaft.

known_defects.reason: Grip animation contracts the spring 4%, but at scale 1 its inner surface already touches the drum.
known_defects.fix: Released coil radius 11.2 mm; grip scale from accessory_gears.spring_grip_scale() stops 0.1 mm off the surface.

known_defects.reason: As for the drum: the contracted spring is driven into the wheel hub.
Focus clips leave the oil/tach shaft still while the cam gear it is splined into turns, so the splines collide.
known_defects.fix: Rig turns parts listed in accessory_gears.SPLINED_TO with their host gear in every clip.

known_defects.reason: As for the cam gear: the cluster gear is splined to the same shaft.
The cross-axis worm tunnel (radius 12 about z=77) reaches z=89 and passes through the cover plate (z 85-90).
known_defects.fix: Relieve the cover and gasket around the tunnel boss, or lower the tunnel so it ends below z=84.

known_defects.reason: Same tunnel boss passes through the cover gasket (z 84-85).
Worm axis is 30 mm from the wheel axis; wheel tips (24.8) plus worm core/thread (6/7) reach 31.8, so the worm penetrates the wheel up to 1.8 mm.
known_defects.fix: Move the worm axis, motor and tunnel out to about y=-32.1, or shrink the worm; a true worm-gear mesh needs a throated wheel.
